nodes.label: Журнал изменений
nodes.rationale: Newest entries on top; format: date — what changed (links to decisions).

nodes.label: DSCore
nodes.rationale: Swift core package: own Yrs wrapper via UniFFI, typed document model, strokes, crypto per crypto.md + Keychain, GRDB local store, REST and sync clients; passes all shared test vectors.

nodes.label: yrs-ffi UniFFI wrapper
nodes.rationale: yrs 0.25 vendored with follow_redone fix; Yrs <-> Yjs compatibility checked both ways.

nodes.label: DSEditor
nodes.rationale: iOS editor package on TextKit 2 with all contract blocks and Core Animation pen layer (living stroke).

nodes.label: @datascratch/web-editor
nodes.rationale: TipTap editor over Y.Doc with Canvas pen layer implementing the living stroke.

nodes.label: @datascratch/shared
nodes.rationale: Types and zod schemas of all contracts, crypto, UUIDv7, document model, strokes, sync client with offline queue and in-memory reference server.

nodes.label: @datascratch/test-vectors
nodes.rationale: Deterministic generator and crypto/ids/strokes/document/sync vectors shared by TS and Swift.

nodes.label: Agents MCP server and OAuth 2.1
nodes.rationale: Fastify plugin with MCP server (Streamable HTTP), OAuth 2.1 (CIMD + dynamic registration, PKCE), static tokens, REST /v1/agent/*, audit log, limits, handwriting PNG rendering.

nodes.label: apps/server
nodes.rationale: Fastify + zod, PostgreSQL via Drizzle, full REST API, WebSocket sync, RLS for agents, pg-boss.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions VPS deploy (deploy.yml, infra/deploy)
nodes.rationale: Images in GHCR, idempotent server prep over SSH, migrations, HTTPS/WebSocket checks, automatic rollback; Caddy serves web on same domain.

nodes.label: AgentsContext server implementation
nodes.rationale: Grants, OAuth and agent journal in PostgreSQL, decryption via DS_KMS_KEY, Row-Level Security by grant.

nodes.label: D-58 frames anchor to enclosed line (changelog entry)
nodes.rationale: Owner feedback: frame around phrase skewed and tore on font/page width change; underlines and highlighter unchanged.

nodes.label: D-57 New agent notebooks visible to all connected agents
nodes.rationale: allNotebooks on grant (default on consent screen), migration 0009, RLS rule; read_note attaches photos; get_image; trash_note to trash only.

nodes.label: D-54 amendment: participant's own AI in shared notebooks
nodes.rationale: If owner opened a shared notebook to agents, participant can connect own AI with same role (editor reads/writes, reader reads); migration 0008.

nodes.label: D-56 ds:// custom URL scheme for app links
D-55 Admin backup and migration over SSH
D-53 Revoked device wipes its data
D-52 Server fetches remote images for web paste
nodes.rationale: Web CSP not weakened; private networks forbidden; only images without SVG, <= 20 MB, 15 s.

nodes.label: D-49 Server address entered at login
D-47 iPad at most two adjacent column levels
nodes.rationale: After user feedback on build 10.

nodes.label: D-45 'Created by agent' banner
nodes.rationale: User feedback: an agent-created note shouldn't be highlighted line by line.

nodes.label: D-44 iPad sidebar toggled only by its button
D-43 Device library migrates into account on login
nodes.rationale: Sync was stuck at 'Syncing…' with POST /v1/docs -> 404.

nodes.label: D-42 Own UniFFI wrapper over yrs 0.25
nodes.rationale: Risk R-06 removed.

nodes.label: D-35 Annotation disappears with deleted text
D-21 tech stack / D-22 no custom Rust core
D-25 Redis removed (pg-boss on PostgreSQL)
nodes.rationale: Server runs as one process.

nodes.label: D-26 MinIO removed (files on disk, optional S3)
D-29 Graphify workflow
nodes.rationale: Graphify git hook reacts only to code; tools/graphify_docs.py updates graph after doc edits.

nodes.label: Notebook key rotation (rotate / rotate/done, pendingSinceVersion)
nodes.rationale: rotate covers only active participants; continuation after failure from any owner device via pendingSinceVersion.

nodes.label: SharedItem.agentsMode (sparkle badge)
nodes.rationale: Display only; old servers omit the field.

nodes.label: ds:// URL scheme
nodes.rationale: Universal Links, Associated Domains and DS_WEB_HOST removed: no domain in the build.

nodes.label: device_revoked signal (401 / WebSocket close 4410)
nodes.rationale: Expired token and network errors must never be treated as revocation (classifyApiFailure / APIFailure.classify, vectors api/failures.json).

nodes.label: Admin command /opt/datascratch/ds (backup, backups, restore, key, key-saved)
nodes.rationale: rclone upload removed; infra/DEPLOY.md 'Backup and migration'.

nodes.label: Deploy address masking (infra/deploy/address.sh, DS_DOMAIN secret)
nodes.rationale: Server address must not appear in public deploy logs.

nodes.label: KDF_BOUNDS safe KDF parameters
nodes.rationale: argon2id13, ops 3-10, mem 64-256 MiB; unsafe prelogin params rejected.

nodes.label: 10 GB per-account storage quota
nodes.rationale: Guest and agent writes count to owner; counter kept by DB triggers; DS_SIGNUP=open|closed|invite.

nodes.label: Subscribe limits (MAX_SUBSCRIBE_DOCS 1000, 64 KB pre-auth frames, 16 MB snapshots)
rate_limited with retryAfterMs (pause sending, no reconnect)
POST /v1/fetch-image (SSRF-safe)
nodes.rationale: All IPs checked before request, connect to checked IP, <= 3 redirects re-checked, <= 20 MB, 15 s, image signatures only, 60/min per account, addresses not logged.

nodes.label: Rich paste (HTML/RTF/Markdown -> blocks)
nodes.rationale: One shared rule in spec/04 for web and iOS; one paste = one undo step.

nodes.label: Shared paste test vectors
nodes.rationale: test-vectors/vectors/paste/cases.json; 15 cases identical on web and iOS.

nodes.label: iOS photos and files in notes (AttachmentManager)
nodes.rationale: Images downscaled to 2560 px, encrypted with note key, uploaded in background.

nodes.label: Extended mode build flag
nodes.rationale: DS_EXTENDED_MODE / VITE_DS_EXTENDED_MODE; data unchanged in minimal mode; taskDates inert.

nodes.label: 'One title' document contract
nodes.rationale: Clients never write a template into an empty doc and repair damaged starts on open; triggered by title loss when opening agent/other-device notes before sync.

nodes.label: 'Never delete what you don't understand' rule
nodes.rationale: Web editor was deleting agent codeBlocks with agentEdit mark failing schema validation.

nodes.label: Agent folder tools (create/rename/move/delete_folder, move_note)
nodes.rationale: Agents cannot create notebooks (master key, E2E); delete_folder never deletes notes; migration 0003_agent_move_note.

nodes.label: Handwriting rendering to PNG for agents
nodes.rationale: Strokes grouped by writing pass (time + top-level block), not nearest char; table cells laid out like iOS editor; frame <= 1600x2400 pt, canvas <= 16 Mpx.

nodes.label: Canonical server notebook key (reconcileNotebookKeys)
nodes.rationale: Prod incident 'Ии': two keys for one notebook; app never creates a key for an existing notebook, local differing key becomes retired read-only.

nodes.label: Skipping/quarantining unreadable sync updates
nodes.rationale: One bad update must not stop a document forever; quarantine (v7-quarantine), recovery via last snapshot.

nodes.label: subscribe with since below last snapshot always returns snapshot + tail (sync-protocol §5)
Pause document while key unavailable
nodes.rationale: Missing key != corruption: document waits without skipping or moving cursor (KeyUnavailableError, keyAvailable, SyncStatus.held).

nodes.label: SyncStatus summary (pending / held / failed / unreadable / revoked)
Refresh token 60 s replay window
nodes.rationale: A lost response in an unstable network must not revoke the device.

nodes.label: NoteMeta.createdByAgent
nodes.rationale: create_note no longer marks content agentEdit; edit_note still does.

nodes.label: Agent edits banner (Accept all / View history)
Pen palette DSPenToolbar / PenToolbar
nodes.rationale: Per user feedback on build 11; UX in spec/03-pencil.md.

nodes.label: iPad column model Sidebar | List | Document
Caddy CSP fix for agent consent screen
nodes.rationale: Web CSP form-action 'self' blocked redirect back to claude.ai; not applied to /v1, /mcp, /oauth paths anymore.

nodes.label: OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_DOCUMENTS toggle
nodes.rationale: claude.ai unreachable from Russian server region; dynamic registration without outgoing requests.

nodes.label: Free drawing anchor (anchorKind block, strokes §4)
nodes.rationale: Feedback: drawing below text vanished on pen lift (iOS searched for a letter only within ±90 pt and dropped the rest). PROPOSED.

nodes.label: Stored document mode (live Y.Doc only for open notes)
nodes.rationale: 10,000 notes ≈ 49 MB instead of ≈ 490 MB.

nodes.label: Recovery key rotation and security events log
WCAG AA text colors in design tokens
Deploy co-hosting modes (inspect, behind-proxy, next to Sinhron)
nodes.rationale: Existing Docker, ufw and foreign containers on a shared server are left untouched.

nodes.label: DSEditor demo crash bisect (-bareEditorProbe)
nodes.rationale: Bare EditorView in app process passes tap+type: defect is only in demo process.

nodes.label: Mermaid hidden WebView in separate invisible window
nodes.rationale: Its gesture recognizers caused random UIKit crashes on text tap.

nodes.label: Local library migration into account on login
Stroke re-anchoring on block restructure (captureAnchorOffsets -> reanchorStrokes)
iOS editor keeps top visible line during width change (fullscreen, Split View, rotation)
